name: vibesdk-llm-client
description: Provider-agnostic LLM inference client -- direct HTTP calls to Anthropic/OpenAI/Google AI Studio (no vendor SDK dependency), keyed by aws/model-config-defaults's `provider/model-name` id convention. The foundational primitive worker/agents/inferutils/core.ts's executeInference plays for the CF build; not a port of that file (1150 lines of retry/fallback/schema-repair/tool-loop orchestration this package doesn't attempt), just the one real HTTP call underneath it. Not part of the main vibesdk build.
